Apply the stated save factor to each type and floor each half separately. For competing flat damage reductions governed by CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md, select only the strongest applicable flat amount for this event, not one winner at each stage. An explicit after-resistance clause changes the selected source's stage; it does not independently authorize stacking with another competing class flat reduction. If equal amounts from different sources remain tied and no exact accepted priority decides them, NEW Ice-Storm-only tie completion: use ascending immutable source-card ID, then original owner ID and application ID. Freeze that selection before allocation and do not optimize it using later resistance, temporary HP, Wounds, or the player's preferred outcome. Independent barriers, explicit reductions outside that strongest-class-DR arbitration and real sharing operations retain their separate source permissions and stages; this rule neither creates them nor deletes them.

At the selected source's actual reduction stage, aggregate all currently eligible amounts of the same canonical damage type. Let B=min(the selected source's flat reduction, the sum of its eligible nonnegative typed amounts). Allocate B in exact rational proportion to those amounts. Give each type the floor of its share, then assign remaining integer points to the largest fractional remainders, with exact ties in ascending canonical damage-type ID. A zero amount receives no allocation. Splitting one type into dice or rows cannot change the result. Do not reduce any component below zero, apply a source's flat amount once per type, or select an allocation using later immunity/resistance. Use exact rationals or equivalent integer arithmetic, not floating-point tie guesses.

An ordinary selected class reduction resolves before resistance/immunity; then apply each actual typed defense and round under its source. A selected Spinal Plating or other exact after-resistance reduction acts on the amounts remaining after that stage instead. Retain surviving typed lineage through any actual later barrier, sharing or transfer. Resolve one grouped original-recipient temporary-HP/HP/Wound/zero event.
